invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieTable object, so result should not be null upon method exit.
The parameter config is used to create the table and should not be null.
The parameter storageConf is provided and expected to be non-null as it likely configures storage.
If validation is skipped, the result is still expected to be non-null.
The returned result is expected to be an instance of HoodieTable or its subclass.
